profile.headline: Software Engineering Manager | Engineering Leader | Champion of Code Quality, Process Optimization & Scalable Software Solutions
profile.summary:
Agile Development | Automation Tools | Backlog Prioritization | Career/Team Development | Client Issue Resolution | Continuous Improvement | Cross-Functional Teams | Customer-Centric | Crisis Management | Development Processes | Efficiency | Engineering Best Practices | Escalation Management | Incident Response | Integrations | IT Service Management | Kanban | Mentorship | Operations Scaling | Peer Code Reviews | Performance Tracking | Problem Solving | Process Automation | Reconciliation Accuracy | Scrum | SLA Compliance | Software Initiatives | Sprint Planning | Strategic Thinking | Support Operations | System Monitoring | Technical Contributor | Troubleshooting | Unit Testing

With over 16 years of experience in software development and support, I currently drive cross-functional collaboration as Software Support Manager at Bestpass. My key focus is ensuring seamless incident escalation, SLA compliance, and delivering exceptional customer experiences. Passionate about fostering a culture of mentorship and continuous improvement, I align team goals with organizational objectives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency.  

At Bestpass, I lead structured sprint planning and mentor engineers through career development plans, enabling the team to achieve quarterly objectives effectively. By implementing streamlined incident management processes, we have significantly improved service reliability and customer satisfaction. My expertise spans SDLC, continuous delivery, and fostering a collaborative environment to meet organizational goals.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading technical initiatives across workflow automation, AI-powered document processing, and business-critical software platforms. Partnering with leadership, operations teams, and distributed developers to deliver scalable solutions using ASP.NET Core, SQL Server, Azure, and Azure DevOps.
 
Key contributions include:
- Leading implementation of Azure AI Document Intelligence solutions for OCR, document classification, and workflow automation. 
- Providing technical leadership through architecture discussions, code reviews, SDLC governance, and release management. 
- Coordinating development efforts across stakeholders and offshore teams to improve delivery effectiveness and operational efficiency. 
- Troubleshooting complex production issues and driving root-cause analysis across application, database, and cloud infrastructure components.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure · ASP.NET Core · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Technical Leadership · Business Process Automation

positions.title: Indie App Developer/Consultant
positions.description: Have a few apps in the ios App Store.  Kids ABC Order is the most successful one as of yet.  Also do side consultant work when I can find it.

positions.title: Software Support Manager
positions.description:
I successfully led cross-functional teams to drive software support and development initiatives at Bestpass, achieving significant improvements in product quality and customer satisfaction.  

• Oversaw incident response and escalation management, maintaining SLA compliance and enhancing customer experience.  
• Mentored engineers through career development plans, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and skill enhancement.  
• Implemented structured sprint planning, enabling teams to meet quarterly objectives effectively.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the crucial data transfer between external agencies/partners to and from Bestpass systems. Monitored the systems to make sure they were functioning optimally and correctly.
• Scaled operations from a 4-agency network to a system processing over $2M+ in toll transactions daily.
• Automated $10M in manual payment processing via web automation, reclaiming 8 hours per week and significantly boosting efficiency.
• Developed remote process automation tools to retrieve daily agency account balances, improving reconciliation speed and accuracy.
• Integrated and supported multiple state tolling agencies  data sources to track toll usages and vehicle updates across Oklahoma, Kansas, North Carolina, Florida, NY (EZpass), Pennsylvania, New Jersey and more.

positions.title: Director of Development Operations
positions.description: Ran the development side of things at Transfinder, from SVN and GIT to coding new features in the products.  The development team ranged from 6-9 developers.  While continuing to code on a daily basis also lead the team with new features and bug fixes.

positions.title: Development Operations Manager
positions.description: Lead the operations team with adding features and such for all the Transfinder products.

positions.title: Development Team Lead
positions.description: Lead a team ranging from 1-4 working on the Flagship desktop routing product and also website products while also working on day to day programming tasks.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Added features to the flagship routing product and also website products.

positions.title: Development Team Leader
positions.description: Maintained and Enhanced modules for research administration enterprise application suite, ensuring projects are completed on time and meet corporate quality standards.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description: While working on the day-to-day programming work I managed about 10 people.

positions.title: Software Developement Engineer
positions.description: Created web and internal data entry screens and customized reports for clients.  Utilized asp, javascript, SQL Server 2000 and Foxpro 6.0.

projects.title: Infofinder Mobile
projects.description: Native iPad application used to access student and transportation data from anywhere.
